assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is medically necessary to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management.
The service directly supports the diagnosis of paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and atrial fibrillation.
The CPT code for the service is 93229.
The diagnosis code for atrial fibrillation is I48.91.
The diagnosis code for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia is I47.1.
